acceptance: Decide whether to auto-merge mirror PRs after their checks or make t3:drift tolerate a pending mirror. Triage #3906. State when bot-managed issues #2471 and #3511 may be closed and stay closed.
description: Mirror PRs #3629, #3635, #3656, #3790 (closed unmerged) and #3906 (open for develop@cd374960) needed hand merging. Until one merges, the nightly t3:drift corpus step is red and bot issue #2471 reopens (closed 2026-10-28 with evidence, reopened 2026-10-28 and 2026-10-29 by github-actions). Issue #3511 (trunk duration alarm) likewise reopened after closure. #3906 was not merged by this session because the earlier instruction named only #3635 and #3656.
